attempts.summary: Configured persistent filesystem-native XFS quota enforcement for datauser under /srv/data. The account has a 100 MiB soft/hard limit, over-limit writes fail with “Disk quota exceeded,” and quota enforcement plus stored data survived node1’s restart. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were retained.
